title: TCS NQT Foundation Mock Test 1
description: Simulates the TCS National Qualifier Test Foundation section (Section A): Verbal Ability (25Q/25min), Reasoning Ability (20Q/25min), and Numerical/Quantitative Ability (20Q/25min). Total: 65 questions in 75 minutes.

questions.text: Choose the word most similar in meaning to 'BENEVOLENT'.
questions.explanation: Benevolent means well-meaning and kindly.

questions.text: Choose the word most OPPOSITE in meaning to 'DILIGENT'.
questions.explanation: Diligent means hardworking; its antonym is lazy.

questions.text: Select the correctly spelled word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'Accommodate' with double 'c' and double 'm'.

questions.text: Fill in the blank: He was so tired that he could _____ walk.
questions.explanation: 'Barely' correctly implies he had almost no energy to walk.

questions.text: Identify the error in: 'Each of the students have submitted their assignment.'
questions.explanation: 'Each' is singular, so it should be 'has submitted'.

questions.text: Choose the word closest in meaning to 'EPHEMERAL'.
questions.explanation: Ephemeral means lasting for a very short time.

questions.text: Fill in the blank: The manager asked his team to _____ the project by Monday.
questions.explanation: After 'to' (infinitive), use the base form 'complete'.

questions.text: Choose the antonym of 'VERBOSE'.
questions.explanation: Verbose means using more words than necessary; concise is the opposite.

questions.text: Identify the correctly punctuated sentence.
questions.explanation: 'It's' is the contraction of 'It is'.

questions.text: Choose the word that best fits: 'The politician's speech was full of _____ — promising everything without substance.'
questions.explanation: Rhetoric here means grand-sounding but empty language.

questions.text: Select the sentence with correct subject-verb agreement.
options: The team plays well together yesterday.
questions.explanation: 'Team' as a collective noun uses singular verb 'is' in formal usage.

questions.text: Choose the synonym of 'OBSTINATE'.
questions.explanation: Obstinate means stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion.

questions.text: In the sentence 'He denied stealing the money', the word 'stealing' is a ___.
questions.explanation: A gerund is the -ing form of a verb used as a noun (object of 'denied').

questions.text: Fill in: The results of the experiment _____ announced yesterday.
questions.explanation: 'Results' is plural, so 'were' is correct.

questions.text: Choose the closest meaning to the phrase 'BEAT AROUND THE BUSH'.
questions.explanation: This idiom means to avoid talking about the main subject.

questions.text: Identify the sentence in passive voice.
options: The letter was written by her.
questions.explanation: Passive voice: subject receives the action. 'The letter was written by her.'

questions.text: Choose the word most similar to 'LUCID'.
questions.explanation: Lucid means easy to understand; clear.

questions.text: Fill in: Neither the manager nor the employees _____ responsible for the error.
questions.explanation: With 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject ('employees' = plural).

questions.text: Choose the correctly written sentence.
questions.explanation: 'Have gone' is the correct present perfect form.

questions.text: The word 'AMELIORATE' means:
questions.explanation: Ameliorate means to make something bad better.

questions.text: Fill in: She asked me where _____ going.
questions.explanation: In reported speech, statement word order is used: 'I was'.

questions.text: Choose the antonym of 'FRUGAL'.
questions.explanation: Frugal means careful with money; extravagant is the opposite.

questions.text: Identify the correct one-word substitution for 'One who knows everything'.
questions.explanation: Omniscient means having complete or unlimited knowledge.

questions.text: Choose the word that is spelled correctly.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'Achieve'. Remember: 'i' before 'e' except after 'c'.

questions.text: Fill in: The principal, along with his teachers, _____ attending the seminar.
questions.explanation: When 'along with' separates the subject from the verb, the verb agrees with the main subject 'principal' (singular).

questions.text: In a row of 40 students, Arjun is 15th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = (Total + 1) - Position from left = 41 - 15 = 26.

questions.text: Pointing to a photo, Raj says 'She is the daughter of my grandfather's only son.' How is she related to Raj?
questions.explanation: Grandfather's only son = Raj's father. Father's daughter = Raj's sister.

questions.text: If COMPUTER is coded as RFUVQNPC, how is PRINTER coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted +1: P→Q, R→S, I→J, N→O, T→U, E→F, R→S = QSJOUFS.

questions.text: A is B's sister. C is B's mother. D is C's father. E is D's mother. How is A related to D?
questions.explanation: D is C's father. C is B's mother. B is A's brother. So D is A's grandfather → A is D's granddaughter.

questions.text: What comes next in the series: 2, 5, 10, 17, 26, ?
questions.explanation: Differences: 3, 5, 7, 9, 11. Next = 26 + 11 = 37.

questions.text: If 'CAT' = 24, 'DOG' = 26, then 'PIG' = ?
questions.explanation: C(3)+A(1)+T(20)=24, D(4)+O(15)+G(7)=26, P(16)+I(9)+G(7)=32. Wait, that gives 32. Actually each letter's position: P=16+I=9+G=7=32. Hmm, but the pattern might be different. Let me recalculate: CAT = 3+1+20=24 ✓, DOG = 4+15+7=26 ✓, PIG = 16+9+7=32. Answer should be 32.

questions.text: Complete the analogy: Book : Library :: Painting : ?
questions.explanation: Books are kept in a library; paintings are kept in a gallery.

questions.text: Find the odd one out: Triangle, Square, Circle, Cube.
questions.explanation: Triangle, Square, and Circle are 2D shapes; Cube is a 3D shape.

questions.text: In a certain code, 'MOUSE' is written as 'PRUVI'. How is 'CHAIR' written?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted +3: C+3=F, H+3=K, A+3=D, I+3=L, R+3=U → FKDLU.

questions.text: If the day before yesterday was Thursday, what day will be the day after tomorrow?
questions.explanation: Day before yesterday = Thursday → Yesterday = Friday → Today = Saturday → Tomorrow = Sunday → Day after tomorrow = Monday.

questions.text: A man walks 5 km North, turns right and walks 3 km, then turns right and walks 5 km. How far is he from the starting point?
questions.explanation: He ends up 3 km East of starting point. Distance = 3 km.

questions.text: Six people A, B, C, D, E, F sit in a row. A is to the left of B. C is to the right of B. D is between E and F. Who sits in the middle if A, B, C are consecutive?
questions.explanation: Order A-B-C, so B sits in the middle of these three.

questions.text: Which number replaces the '?' : 4, 9, 25, 49, 121, ?
questions.explanation: These are squares of prime numbers: 2²=4, 3²=9, 5²=25, 7²=49, 11²=121, 13²=169.

questions.text: All lions are tigers. Some tigers are elephants. Which conclusion is definitely true?
questions.explanation: Since some tigers are elephants, it follows that some elephants are tigers (conversion).

questions.text: A clock shows 3:15. What is the angle between the hour and minute hands?
questions.explanation: Minute hand at 90°. Hour hand at 3*30 + 15*0.5 = 90+7.5 = 97.5°. Difference = 7.5°.

questions.text: Rearrange: PLEAP. This is a _____.
questions.explanation: PLEAP rearranged = APPLE, which is a fruit.

questions.text: If P is taller than Q, Q is taller than R, and R is taller than S, who is the shortest?
questions.explanation: P > Q > R > S, so S is the shortest.

questions.text: Complete: ACE, BDF, CEG, ?
questions.explanation: Pattern: each letter increases by 1. A+1=B, B+1=C, C+1=D; C+1=D, E+1=F, E+1=F... actually ACE→BDF (each +1), BDF→CEG (+1), CEG→DFH (+1).

questions.text: A is 2 years older than B. B is 3 years younger than C. If C is 20 years old, how old is A?
Statements: Some cats are dogs. All dogs are birds. Conclusion: Some cats are birds.
questions.explanation: Some cats are dogs (given). All dogs are birds. Therefore, some cats are birds (syllogism).

questions.text: A train 200m long passes a pole in 10 seconds. What is the speed of the train in km/h?
A shopkeeper marks up an item by 25% and then gives a discount of 20%. What is the net profit or loss %?
questions.explanation: Net = 1.25 × 0.80 = 1.00. So no profit, no loss (0%).

questions.text: What is the compound interest on Rs. 10,000 at 10% p.a. for 2 years, compounded annually?
If 15 men can complete a work in 12 days, how many days will 20 men take to complete the same work?
Two numbers are in the ratio 3:5. Their LCM is 75. What is their HCF?
questions.explanation: Let numbers be 3x and 5x. LCM = 15x = 75 → x=5. Numbers: 15, 25. HCF = 5.

questions.text: A sum triples in 10 years at simple interest. What is the rate of interest?
A can finish a job in 12 days, B in 15 days. Both work together for 5 days, then A leaves. How many more days does B take to finish?
questions.explanation: Together per day: 1/12+1/15 = 9/60 = 3/20. In 5 days: 15/20 = 3/4. Remaining: 1/4. B per day: 1/15. Days = (1/4)/(1/15) = 15/4 ≈ 3.75 ≈ 3 days (nearest whole number check: 3 days leaves fraction, but closest answer is 3).

questions.text: Find the value of x: 3x + 7 = 25.
A circle has area 154 cm². What is its circumference? (π = 22/7)
questions.explanation: πr² = 154 → r² = 154×7/22 = 49 → r = 7 cm. Circumference = 2πr = 2×22/7×7 = 44 cm.

questions.text: What percentage of 80 is 20?
The average of 5 numbers is 40. If one number is removed, the average becomes 35. What was the removed number?
questions.explanation: Sum of 5 = 200. Sum of 4 = 140. Removed = 200-140 = 60.

questions.text: A boat travels 15 km downstream in 1 hour and 9 km upstream in 1 hour. Find the speed of the stream.
questions.explanation: Speed of stream = (downstream - upstream)/2 = (15-9)/2 = 3 km/h.

questions.text: In how many ways can the letters of 'MATHS' be arranged?
questions.explanation: MATHS has 5 distinct letters. Arrangements = 5! = 120.

questions.text: A ball is drawn from a bag with 4 red, 5 blue, 3 green balls. What is the probability it is NOT blue?
questions.explanation: Total = 12. Not blue = 12-5 = 7. P = 7/12.

questions.text: Find the missing term: 3, 7, 13, 21, 31, ?
questions.explanation: Differences: 4, 6, 8, 10, 12. Next term = 31+12 = 43.

questions.text: The ratio of ages of Aman and Bman is 4:5. After 8 years, the ratio will be 6:7. Find Aman's current age.
What is 15% of 240?
A rectangular room is 12m × 8m. Find the cost of carpeting at Rs. 150 per m².
If 20% of x = 30% of 60, find x.
A tap fills a tank in 6 hours, another empties it in 8 hours. If both open together, how long to fill the tank?
questions.explanation: Net rate = 1/6 - 1/8 = 4/24 - 3/24 = 1/24 per hour. Time = 24 hours.
